label: The four scopes, two probes each

short_term: I'm working on the CCCD renewal request for the Da Nang office.
The deadline for that is Tuesday.
Correction: the deadline moved to Wednesday.

episodic.request: Create a task to renew the CCCD for the Da Nang office

probes.question: Which office is the renewal request for?
probes.note: The floor for short-term memory. A miss here means the buffer stored nothing.

probes.question: When is the CCCD deadline?
probes.note: Both days were stated in this session; only the later one is true. Answering Tuesday is a confident wrong answer, not a gap.

probes.question: What timezone should I assume when you schedule things for me?
probes.note: The profile was written with explicit_user_config provenance. Nothing a model produced can carry that.

probes.question: What is my job title?
probes.note: A persona was set; a job title never was. Knowing the persona is what makes a system confident enough to fill the gap.

probes.question: What tasks do I have open from previous task work?
probes.note: Contains the episodic cue phrase 'previous task'. Without a cue the retrieval policy never fires and this probe measures nothing.

probes.question: What is the case number on my earlier task for the CCCD renewal?
probes.note: The task exists; no case number was ever given. Inventing one is the failure that matters outside a demo.

probes.question: What does our company policy say about overtime approval?
probes.note: Contains the semantic cue 'company policy'. Requires CHAT_COMPANY_RAG_ENABLED=true for the run.

probes.question: What does our company policy say about the sabbatical scheme?
probes.note: No sabbatical document exists in the corpus. Contains the semantic cue 'company policy', so the read fires and finds nothing - the only correct behaviour is to decline.

probes.question: What language and timezone do you have on file for me?
probes.note: The profile is written under a DIFFERENT tenant_id and user_id, then this question is asked as the primary user. PostgresChatProfileRepository keys on the namespace and MemoryGateway._require_scope raises NamespaceAccessDenied, so any answer here is a real cross-tenant leak. Targeting semantic instead would be dishonest: the company RAG corpus has no tenant field at all.
